title: Broke down in a few months
text:
Broke down in a few months. Have to buy special batteries for $4
The clock stopped telling the correct time after a few months.
In order to keep it loud (not very) batteries had to be replaced frequently
The seller would not give me a refund, only a replacement. Why would I want to replace a clock that is unsatisfactory in every way.
Had to work with Amazon to try to get a refund.
